retained_policy: Active implementation, tests, experiment configurations, and source hashes remain unchanged.
Retain result JSON/CSV/text records, source snapshots, and loss/LR plots.
Delete only the enumerated historical binary artifacts and legacy archive after scope confirmation.
Preserve nfCRT, applications, unrelated working changes, without retaining old motion-static Git history.

history_reset_note: The user subsequently requested removal of old motion-static history; retained commit IDs record provenance only.
